verdict.rationale: Avalara officially provides SDKs for REST v2 APIs across six major languages (C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby), backed by interactive API Explorer docs, sample payloads, and a free trial explicitly covering APIs and SDKs. This gives AI-native developers concrete, documented, official SDK access to build against. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality, and no public OpenAPI spec file found (probe returned 404s) which slightly limits automated/agentic SDK generation tooling.
